description: This CSS file contains styling for a simple todo list application, including theme management for light and dark modes, and various classes that define the layout and appearance of the app components.

classes.name: App
classes.description: The main container for the application, styling includes text alignment, background color, and transition effects.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Styling for the application logo including height and pointer event settings.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header styling for the application, including background color, layout using flexbox, and responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Styling for links within the application, defining color and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styling for the theme toggle button including positioning, background color, text color, and hover effects.
